evidence: spectrum_integral true with 4 distinct eigenvalues 120, 8, -1, -36 (Kneser K(n,3) has k+1 = 4 distinct eigenvalues, alternating sign pattern)

reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 66. Lower bound is an independent set of size 66 (check passed; matches cpsat_alpha 66, proven). Upper bound is a linear code M = I + A over F_7 of length 66 (code_fits, factorization and decoding checks all passed), found with 1 code tried. Versus baselines: cpsat_cover only reached 78 unproven in 120.5 s, frac_cover gave 71.5, f2_minrank_sat gave no value (lower 65); the agent beat all of these on accuracy. kushagra_agent also reached the exact 66 via F_7 in 0.041 s, while this agent took 32.481 s wall, almost all LLM time (llm_s 32.426, compute_s 0.054), so it lost clearly on time. Nothing suspicious: the hypothesis K(13,3) and field 7 agree with kushagra_agent.
